title: Watch: Highlights as England beat France 6-4 in third-place play-off
originalTitle: Watch: Highlights as England beat France 6-4 in third-place play-off
content:
Bukayo Saka scores a hat-trick as England beat France 6-4 in a thriller to record their best men's World Cup finish since 1966.
